startup_requires: New explicit finite authorization, fresh shared quota snapshot, real activity balance, original ledger usage and absolute deadline. This file grants no permission.

mechanisms.hypothesis: Returns of previously similar stocks contain incremental information about subsequent own-stock returns, after controlling own reversal, trend and risk. Information diffusion is an unproved interpretation.

definition.clock: Asia/Shanghai; form after T closing data are available; enter next actual session open; never trade at T close
definition.source_universe: Original fixed 80 symbols in night_factor_20261020/local-data/capture.json; supplied-source falsification only, not representative all-A or pool coverage
definition.calendar: Original independently stored 320-session baostock calendar; reindex full stock/calendar grid and preserve unknown cells
definition.market: m[t]=median finite r[j,t] over frozen universe, only with at least60 securities; x[i,t]=r[i,t]-m[t]
definition.peer_estimation: At T use exactly60 calendar returns T-64 through T-5 inclusive. Eligible securities have all60 finite x and strictly positive variance; require at least60 eligible securities. Pearson correlations use only these complete arrays.
definition.peers: For each i choose the five highest strictly positive correlations with other eligible securities; ties by ascending six-digit symbol. Fewer than five gives undefined. Selection never uses T-4..T returns or future quotes.
definition.score: s[i,T]=mean over frozen five peers j of SUM(x[j,t],t=T-4..T) - SUM(x[i,t],t=T-4..T). All six recent paths must be complete; missing selected peers give undefined, with no substitute selection.
definition.numeric_rule: Constant arrays undefined, no epsilon signal creation or missing-value fill. Before labels, exact small fixtures, prefix/order invariance and an independently calculated Pearson oracle must pass for the frozen implementation.
definition.execution: Existing prepare_study/evaluate_study holdings, cash, fees and potential daily-bar fills; unknown quote/status is pending, never zero return or future-based deletion

mechanisms.difference_from_prior_failures: Predicts cross-security transfer beyond own r1/r5/r20. C1 pressure, own up-day breadth, MAX20, own prior peak and unsigned volume/magnitude coupling have no previously estimated peer-return term. Visible task catalog differs; the historical baseline count654 is not a complete novelty certificate.
mechanisms.strongest_alternative: Ordinary own-stock reversal plus shared industry/market risk, illiquidity or stale quotes generates the entire apparent effect.

cheapest_discriminating_test.label: Arithmetic adjusted OPEN[T+6]/OPEN[T+1]-1 on the same independently calendared sample. Label failures are logged after legal signal selection and never change portfolio eligibility.
cheapest_discriminating_test.fit: Per formation date, one fixed full-rank least-squares specification. Center and L2-normalize nonconstant regressors; SVD relative tolerance1e-10. Keep all eight columns; require60 common observations and at least10 residual degrees of freedom, else pending, never drop a control to obtain significance. Restore score coefficient to rank units.
cheapest_discriminating_test.target: Mean coefficient of centered score rank; a one-unit rank difference represents its conditional five-session return contrast
cheapest_discriminating_test.time_segments: Four consecutive blocks of equal numbers of scheduled formation dates, with any remainder in the last block; report every block, including missing estimates
cheapest_discriminating_test.uncertainty: Moving block bootstrap of date coefficients, block length4 formation slots,9999 draws,seed20261020,95% percentile interval. Preserve missing formation slots; draw contiguous scheduled slots, omit missing coefficients only inside each draw and report valid counts. Require at least24 estimated dates, at least6 per segment and120 calendar sessions; otherwise limited evidence, not confirmation.
cheapest_discriminating_test.risk_scope: Without as-of industry metadata this test does not exclude industry risk or prove a causal diffusion mechanism. No actual current-pool common ledger, hence no pool-increment pass.

windows.qualification: Both windows have prior research exposure; neither is newly sealed OOS. Confirmation unavailable means pending, no window substitution. Future forward shadow must be frozen before its labels exist.

frozen_decisions.stop_fixed_definition: 95% upper bound of the conditional effect below0.001, or existing fixed_definition_weak jointly on both cost paths and same-support market wealth. Close this version only; no sign, peer count, lookback, group or window rescue.
frozen_decisions.research_value: Implementable and not decisively excluded; uncertain effect or unavailable execution/confirmation evidence remains pending. A point estimate alone cannot buy a website run.
frozen_decisions.shadow_candidate: Estimated effect positive and not materially excluded, positive net excess at both fixed costs,30bp net Sharpe at least0.5, positive net excess in at least3 of4 segments, complete scoped source/execution evidence and a usable unchanged-definition confirmation. This remains a pre-forward candidate, not a pool increment pass.
frozen_decisions.pool_review: Existing prospective admission policy, original source/PIT gates, actual pool common ledger and forward shadow independently satisfied; never inferred from this plan, CI or model agreement.
frozen_decisions.do_not_spend: Known semantic/numeric error, local scoped weakness, unresolved fundamental PIT, or website cannot answer the recorded question. Do not buy a summary as a substitute for an unavailable trading ledger.

mechanisms.website_question_if_needed: Only after free adaptation/preflight and explicit new authorization: does the exact frozen definition on an explicitly declared provider universe show the frozen long-side RankIC/Sharpe/excess? A larger provider peer universe changes peer identities and must be bound as a separate domain-specific implementation, never called the same fixed80 reproduction. Check data size/compute feasibility offline first; unavailable universe support or excessive cost means stop. Summaries cannot certify local execution gaps, financial PIT or actual pool increment.

process: Before any new return labels: bind exact code, source/codes/calendar, controls, protocol hash and existing scientific registration; log all related prior exposures.

Deterministic local inputs/numeric/semantics tests and existing engine first. One independent Skeptic reviews only issues that could change the advance decision; seed definition does not need a second proposal.

No-model fixed planning/accounting/freeze/conclusion. Reviewer sees exact current artifacts and scoped evidence. Explicit material objections may use remaining bounded attempts; no ceremonial cross-role rounds.

Do not allocate primary website reservation above8 or primary worker attempts above8; preserve the other allocations. Recheck actual charges and earliest absolute deadline before any launch; retries consume the same cumulative bounds.
If no actionable new material, stop and save the blocker. Never wake models to check the clock. End by normal host stop, process/state and unsettled-run audit.
